body:
1. Top 3 at a Pet Show counts as a win, only for the license. Prizes and the 'Win the Pet Show' quest stay 1st place. Counting starts at the update.
2. Level 1: 1 win + 1 healthy week. Level 2: 2 wins + 2 healthy weeks. Level 3: 3 wins (one of them 1st place) + 3 healthy weeks.
3. Healthy week: no pet of yours sick, care on 3 or more days (see the ribbon).
4. Judge Sir Barkley hands each level over on the Pet Show podium.
5. Never taken away.
6. Snake, monkey, seal: level 1. Bear: level 3. Level 2 is the step on the way.
7. License card in 🐾 My pets: your level and what's next.
8. Ms. Paws: "A bear needs an animal license level 3. Finish top 3 at 3 Pet Shows, once in 1st place!" Shop: 🔒 Animal license 3.

title: Animal license: 3 levels from the Pet Show
